sentence: This project builds tools that use images and videos from traffic cameras, smartphones and drones to forecast and manage floods.
This project builds computing systems from miniature 3D models of the human brain grown from stem cells and tests how they process information.
This project studies how the radical cations of guanine and 8-oxoguanine react with nitric oxide and nitrogen dioxide using mass spectrometry.
This project studies the limits of what intelligent systems can do, in areas such as computer vision and human-robot interaction.
This project builds a wireless system that uses low-power panels to amplify and steer radio signals over long distances on farms.
This project studies how whirligig beetles move on and under the water, dive, and use surface ripples to detect food particles.
This project builds a machine-learning tool that copies a physical lake model to infer past temperatures from lake sediment cores.
This project designs hospital robots that work on their own, share information with cloud computers only when needed, and learn as a team.
This project builds a system that uses computer vision and machine learning to support two-way communication between Deaf and hearing people.
This project studies how a group of fungi called Basidiobolus makes unique chemicals and whether some of the genes came from bacteria.
This project uses mathematical models of cancer to build virtual patient populations and test many interventions by simulation.
This project tries to find out which genes and molecules let Drosophila recruit and keep symbiotic bacteria in its foregut.
This project builds a framework that makes digital materials from ordinary photographs and refines them step by step.
This project tries to store quantum information from superconducting qubits in long-lived spin ensembles.
This project measures greenhouse gas emissions from forested wetlands and tests whether satellites can detect them.
This project builds a system that uses head movement to identify users of extended reality devices, using neural networks.
This project studies how computers can learn to understand 3D objects and the results of actions on them, from 3D point cloud data.
